extensions.tokenFormat: Colors are hex values in src/app/tokens.css, in two tiers: ramps, which only that file references, and roles, which everything else consumes as var(--mgn-role) or as a utility from globals.css.

reservedColors.note: Applied by no component. Reserved for data visualization. Not interface colors.

title.purpose: Page titles and the wordmark. 20/24 semibold.

heading.purpose: Dialog, card and section headings. 16/20 semibold.

code.purpose: JetBrains Mono 13/22. Documents, editors, index specs, variable names.

motion.name: sidebar-slide
motion.purpose: The only layout animation in the system. Sidebar width, left and right during offcanvas collapse.

motion.name: overlay-enter
motion.purpose: Dialog, alert dialog and sheet enter and exit.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Controls, rows and tabs. Color only, never layout.

motion.name: skeleton-pulse
motion.value: animate-pulse on a hover fill block
motion.purpose: The only loading affordance. No spinners anywhere in the product.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: The only breakpoint in the system. Defined once in useIsMobile as MOBILE_BREAKPOINT and mirrored by Tailwind's md:. Below it, the sidebar becomes an 18rem sheet behind a fixed two-row header.

dimensions.name: sidebar-width
dimensions.purpose: Desktop rail. Set by the app shell as --sidebar-width, overriding the sidebar component's own 16rem default.

dimensions.name: mobile-header
dimensions.purpose: Fixed top bars below 768px, cleared by 7rem of content top margin.

focusRing.purpose: focus-fill on filled controls with a 1px gap, focus-field replacing a border, focus-row inside rows and tabs.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one default action of a region.
components.css: .ds-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.375rem; height: 1.75rem; padding: 0 0.75rem; border-radius: 4px; font-family: var(--mgn-font-ui), ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; line-height: 1rem; cursor: pointer; border: 0; background: var(--mgn-brand-fill); color: var(--mgn-on-brand); } .ds-primary:hover { background: var(--mgn-brand-fill-hover); } .ds-primary:active { background: var(--mgn-brand-fill-pressed); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--mgn-focus); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Every other button with a label.
components.css: .ds-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.375rem; height: 1.75rem; padding: 0 0.75rem; border-radius: 4px; font-family: var(--mgn-font-ui), ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; line-height: 1rem; cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid var(--mgn-control-border); background: var(--mgn-control-button); color: var(--mgn-text); } .ds-outline:hover { border-color: var(--mgn-control-border-hover); } .ds-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--mgn-focus); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Search Input
components.css: .ds-input { box-sizing: border-box; height: 1.75rem; padding: 0 0.5rem; border: 1px solid var(--mgn-control-border); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--mgn-control); color: var(--mgn-text); font-family: var(--mgn-font-ui), ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; line-height: 1rem; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--mgn-text-secondary); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--mgn-focus); outline-offset: -1px; }

components.name: Tree Row
components.description: A collection in the sidebar, selected by fill.
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; height: 1.5rem; padding: 0 0.5rem; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--mgn-selection); color: var(--mgn-text); font-family: var(--mgn-font-ui), ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; line-height: 1rem; } .ds-row-meta { color: var(--mgn-on-selection-secondary); font-size: 0.75rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Framed Panel
components.description: Chrome header, content body, one 8px frame.
components.css: .ds-panel { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--mgn-separator); border-radius: 8px; color: var(--mgn-text); font-family: var(--mgn-font-ui), ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; line-height: 1rem; } .ds-panel-head { padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--mgn-separator); background: var(--mgn-surface-chrome); } .ds-panel-body { padding: 0.75rem; background: var(--mgn-surface-content); font-family: var(--mgn-font-code), monospace; }

components.name: Banner
components.css: .ds-banner { padding: 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--mgn-danger-line); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--mgn-danger-soft); color: var(--mgn-text); font-family: var(--mgn-font-ui), ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; line-height: 1rem; }

components.name: Badge
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 1.25rem; padding: 0 0.375rem; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--mgn-brand-soft); color: var(--mgn-on-brand-soft); font-family: var(--mgn-font-ui), sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; }

narrative.overview:
Mongonaut looks like a tool window: quiet gray chrome around a content surface where the documents live. Regions meet at 1px separators, controls are small and exact, and color appears only when it carries a state or marks the one default action.

The system is abstracted from an IDE interface kit. It takes over the kit's roles, proportions and rules. It does not take over its blue accent, its icons or any product marks. Magenta is Mongonaut's accent.
keyCharacteristics: Gray chrome around a content surface that is the lightest in light and the darkest in dark
One magenta accent, as a fill with white text
Selection by fill, with unchanged text
28px controls and 24px rows on desktop, a larger ladder on touch
Shadows only on surfaces that left the page

rules.name: The Role Rule
rules.body: Only tokens.css may reference a ramp or write a color value. Components use utilities, and third party editors receive var(--mgn-role).

rules.name: The Swap Rule
rules.body: Changing the accent means replacing the --mgn-brand-* ramp and --mgn-on-brand in both themes. If a component has to change too, a role is missing.

rules.name: The Content Extreme Rule
rules.body: Content is the lightest surface in the light theme and the darkest in the dark theme. Chrome always sits between content and ink.

rules.name: The Three Fills Rule
rules.body: Hover and pressed are neutral, selection is accent tinted. They are never interchangeable: hover must not look selected.

rules.name: The Steady Text Rule
rules.body: Selection changes the fill only. Label color and weight stay as they are, secondary text moves to selection-secondary to keep its contrast, on hovered rows as well.

rules.name: The Accent Step Rule
rules.body: #c725e5 is a fill in both themes and a line on light surfaces. Text and everything on dark surfaces uses the neighboring steps, which keep their contrast.

rules.name: The Danger Ground Rule
rules.body: Danger text sits on content, chrome or danger-soft, never on the hover or selection fill. Destructive actions hover with danger-soft.

rules.name: The Two Weights Rule
rules.body: Regular and semibold. No medium, no bold.

rules.name: The Default Size Rule
rules.body: 13px is the working size, 12px the minimum. Inputs use 16px below 768px so phones do not zoom.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Numbers a user may compare use tabular figures.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: No uppercase styling and no letter spacing.

rules.name: The Single Breakpoint Rule
rules.body: 768px is the only breakpoint, defined in useIsMobile and mirrored by md:.

rules.name: The One Default Rule
rules.body: at most one accent button per region. Dialogs put Cancel first and the default action last.

dos: Give each region one accent button.
Pair every status color with an icon or a word.
Put Cancel first and the default action last.
donts: Don't write a color value or a ramp variable outside tokens.css.
Don't use brand-fill as a text color or as a line on a dark surface.
Don't put two accent buttons in one region.
Don't add a shadow to anything that scrolls with the page.
Don't signal selection with bold text, or hover with the selection fill.
Don't hardcode a control height. Use the height variables.
Don't animate layout. Only color changes and the sidebar's width and position. Menus, selects and popovers open and close without animation.
Don't add a second accent. --mgn-series-* is for data visualization only.
